findings.title: Israeli strike on southern Gaza hospital kills five, Gaza civil defence says
findings.location: Nasser Hospital, Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Reuters now reports at least five killed (one more than prior four), including surgeon Rezik Abushira, and 20 injured, and extensive damage to the surgery department. Anadolu independently quotes the hospital director describing intensive care and surgical-ward damage but cites four deaths. Facility service shutdown, surgery continuity, identities or civilian/combatant status of other victims, and exact incident time remain unverified.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: hit the surgery department at Nasser Hospital, causing extensive damage.

bounded_discovery_context.discovery_method: First of 12 targeted post-official searches identified updated Reuters report, opened directly; contemporaneous Reuters syndication and Anadolu item cross-checked.
bounded_discovery_context.change_from_prior: Prior heartbeat reported Nasser Hospital strike with at least four deaths and unspecified several injuries; Reuters now reports five deaths, 20 injuries, identifies surgeon Rezik Abushira as among the dead, and attributes extensive surgery department damage to Gaza Civil Defence.
bounded_discovery_context.source_timestamp_basis: Reuters webpage still displays original 11 Nov 23:26 UTC publication timestamp and does not disclose a precise update time. Reuters syndication at Straits Times is timestamped 12 Nov 07:48 Singapore (11 Nov 15:48 PST) and updated 08:16 Singapore (16:16 PST); full five-death and facility-damage version visible in current copy. Treat as newly observed material follow-up, not proof that the incident happened after previous check.
bounded_discovery_context.overlap_warning: Same Nasser Hospital incident already logged previous hour. This finding updates its impact; the five fatalities must NOT be added to the previous four.
bounded_discovery_context.independent_confirmation: Anadolu also reports extensive damage to surgical and intensive-care wards according to hospital director, but quotes four deaths and partly overlaps Gaza Civil Defence source. No independent confirmation of five-death count or operating status.
bounded_discovery_context.qualification: Material newly reported casualty and healthcare-facility-impact details within recall watch; not a new distinct strike, no production/publication authorization.
